cues.text: A lifting frame raises an iron section from the ground.
Crews work on all four legs of the tower.
A crane turns the next iron section and lowers it into position.
The four legs will meet at the first platform.
An iron section arrives at the first platform, ready for the next lift.
The frame narrows above the second platform.
